title: POST /oauth/init has no route-level regression coverage
reasoning: The route has meaningful behavior at the API boundary: it requires an API key, rejects missing Gmail client configuration, accepts user-controlled redirect_uri input, delegates auth URL generation, and returns a typed response model. No linked tests were provided for this feature, and repository search only found newsletter service tests rather than tests exercising this FastAPI route, so regressions in status codes, auth enforcement, or redirect_uri handling could slip through.
recommendation: Add route-level tests using the FastAPI test client for at least: unauthorized requests, missing Gmail client settings returning 400, successful response shape, and redirect_uri propagation into the generated auth URL.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature lists no tests, and the inspected repository references did not include an oauth_init or /oauth/init route test.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests for POST /newsletters/oauth/init covering 401/403 without API key, 400 when Gmail credentials are absent, and 200 with an auth_url when credentials and redirect_uri are valid.
minimumFixScope: Tests only; no production code change is required for this finding.
